stances.text_zh: 中庭是比較單純的住戶共用空間，是停留的地方，夏季同時也是遮蔭的庭院。
stances.text_en: Courtyards are residents' shared spaces for staying; in summer they are also shaded courts.

stances.text_zh: 冬季陽光與夏季戶外熱舒適都很重要；夏天確實很熱，但冬天公共空間要有陽光才會有人聚集。
stances.text_en: Winter sun and summer outdoor thermal comfort matter equally; public spaces need winter sun for people to gather.
